explication: T3 Code is a cross-platform agent-harness control surface: clients connect to a local or remote T3 server, which coordinates installed coding agents and exposes their work through mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. The principal workflow is client-to-server connection, agent orchestration, and returning live development results. The graph also preserves documented remote access, source control, MCP, and update capabilities. Several server and client subsystems are represented at their exact directories because their implementations were not excerpted; those links rely on README descriptions rather than inspected call sites.
